function: Learns UAV flight speed and direction jointly with sensing and communication transmit powers of an ISAC UAV to minimize average age of information under jamming (p. 7).
system: One ISAC UAV, one BS, one jamming UAV; antenna gains only (no array model), no RIS; OFDM; 3 GHz carrier, 1 MHz bandwidth (p. 3, p. 4, p. 10).
method: TD3 actor-critic deep reinforcement learning (TD3-TP) with information enhancement and reward shaping; two 512-neuron hidden layers; trained by interaction with simulated environment (p. 7, p. 8, p. 10).
data_channel: Custom simulation: probabilistic LoS/NLoS air-to-ground path loss (a=12, b=0.135, eta_NLoS 20), radar equation sensing; random-waypoint attacker; 2500 m x 2500 m area; no dataset (p. 4, p. 10).
test_conditions: Trained up to 20,000 episodes; tested 100 episodes, average AoI; attack power, mode, thresholds, heights swept; retraining per sweep not stated (p. 10, p. 12).
baselines: Learned: DDPG, PPO, TD3 with random power. Non-learned: shortest path by ant colony optimization, flying over task centers at maximum power (p. 11).
metrics: Average AoI, episode AoI and episode reward over training episodes (p. 10, p. 11, p. 12).
complexity: Training O(D Mstep Bm x layer-size products of actor and two critics); inference O(Mstep x layer-size products of actor); no measured runtime (p. 10).
openness: none; only Python 3.9 and PyTorch 1.13.1 are named, no code or data link (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 4: "the probabilistic path loss model [36] for the air-to-ground" - custom probabilistic LoS/NLoS model with constants a, b (Table I, p. 10) and radar equations; no 3GPP TR 38.811/38.901, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 10: "During the testing phase, we evaluate the trained model" - 100 test episodes; no test on a scenario unseen in training is reported, and the sweeps of attack power, thresholds and heights (p. 12, p. 13) do not say the policy is tested without retraining.
q3_support: p. 11: "learning-based algorithms and one traditional heuristic optimization algorithm" - DDPG and PPO (learned) and shortest-path ant colony optimization (non-learned) are compared with the proposed method on average AoI (Figs. 8-12).
q4_support: p. 10: "total training complexity is approximated to be" - big-O for training, and for inference "its complexity is about O(Mstep" times the actor layer-size products; no runtime measured.
q5_support: p. 10: "The simulations are implemented with Python 3.9 and PyTorch 1.13.1." - only software versions are given; no code or data link, public dataset or availability statement in the paper.
notes: Included, area 6: the UAV trajectory (above PHY) is learned jointly with the sensing and communication transmit powers of an aerial ISAC link (p. 7), so the joint-decision rule of above_phy applies; by the order 6 before 5 it is area 6, where single-antenna links are admitted. The reviewer may instead read it as anti-jamming (excluded under function), since the scenario is a jamming attack. Table I (p. 10) was read from the page image. Title and DOI on p. 1 match.
